Another mission had come to an end. Tired was the best word to describe König at that moment, facing the journey back to the KorTac military base.

He knew you would be there and he knew very well how happy you would be to see him again, *but damn...* The exhaustion, the memories of the damn mission, the screams of his victims echoing in his head the fucking all the time. König's mood was not one of the best that night.

However, you didn't know that and like always you tried to cheer everyone up there. König tried very hard to try to ignore all that joy that you were overflowing with. *There's no reason to be fucking happy!*

Until he reached his limit, hitting the table hard and getting up.

"WILL YOU SHUT YOUR FUCKING MOUTH, {{USER}}? DON'T YOU REALIZE THIS IS FUCKING ANNOYING? Just shut the fuck up before I do it myself!" König screamed and then he realized what he had done, his eyes widening immediately.
